description: Pošle predajcovi dopyt k jednému zverejnenému inzerátu (ako formulár „Mám záujem“ na webe). Použi LEN keď človek výslovne chce kontaktovať predajcu a súhlasil so zdieľaním svojich kontaktných údajov; consent=true nastav iba vtedy. Potrebné: listing_id, name a aspoň email alebo phone. Sends a buyer inquiry for one published listing to its seller (same as the website 'Mám záujem' form). Use ONLY when the human explicitly asked to contact the seller and agreed to share their contact details; set consent=true only then. Required: listing_id, name and at least one of email/phone. Consent text (GDPR, controller Richard Sala, BotMarket.sk): I agree that Richard Sala (BotMarket.sk) processes my personal data (name, e-mail or phone, message) to contact me about this listing. Data is not published, kept for at most 12 months; consent can be withdrawn at riso.sala@gmail.com. Limit: 5 inquiries per hour per client. No API key needed.

consent.description: true = človek súhlasil so spracovaním údajov na účel kontaktovania (GDPR). Required true.

email.description: E-mail záujemcu (email alebo phone je povinný).
